import_provenance.original_title: Satisfiability with two variables and one transitive relation
import_provenance.original_statement: Is satisfiability decidable for first-order logic using only two variables when one designated binary relation must be transitive and the remaining relations are unrestricted? The question permits infinite models and continues Kieroński’s work on semantic restrictions in two-variable logic.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Finite satisfiability is already decidable (Pratt-Hartmann, 2018); it must not be conflated with this unrestricted satisfiability question: https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.05558.
